node_streams.label: mpkCCD protein abundance
node_streams.description: Back-transformed mpkCCD protein abundance with the current complement-of-minimum factor.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: No finite positive protein-abundance measurement mapped to the candidate.

normalization.help: Multiplies the empirical q75 threshold calculated from all finite back-transformed protein abundances.

node_streams.label: Principal-cell RNA
node_streams.description: Positive principal-cell median TPM values; zero measurements remain neutral/missing.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: No positive principal-cell TPM measurement; measured zeros count as nondetections.

normalization.help: Multiplies the empirical q75 threshold calculated from positive principal-cell TPM values; zero measurements remain neutral.

node_streams.label: PKA-KO kinase activity
node_streams.description: Absolute-LFC kinase-profile evidence from the top-ten KinasePredictor analysis.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: No kinase-level KinasePredictor activity statistic for an ontology-annotated kinase; non-kinases are out of scope.

normalization.help: Multiplies the q75 threshold from all kinase-level absolute median phosphosite LFC values.

node_streams.label: PKA-KO phosphoprotein response
node_streams.description: Strongest site-level response: at least one positively scoring phosphosite makes the protein a hit.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: No detected phosphosite mapped to the candidate in the PKA-KO phosphoproteomic dataset.

normalization.reference: single all-phosphosite q75; no site-count adjustment
normalization.help: Multiplies the same site-level q75 for every observed phosphosite. The protein inherits its strongest site's factor; additional sites do not raise the threshold or accumulate extra evidence.

node_streams.label: PKA-Cα KO phosphoprotein response
node_streams.description: Strongest site-pattern response after selective Prkaca knockout; one positively scoring site is sufficient.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: No phosphosite pattern from the PKA-Cα-null versus matched-intact comparison mapped to the candidate.

normalization.reference: single source-site q75 = 0.226039 absolute LFC; no site-count adjustment
normalization.help: Multiplies the same PKA-Cα-KO site-level q75 for every site pattern. Each protein inherits its strongest site's factor; proteins without detected sites remain neutral.

node_streams.label: PKA-Cβ KO phosphoprotein response
node_streams.description: Strongest site-pattern response after selective Prkacb knockout; one positively scoring site is sufficient.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: No phosphosite pattern from the PKA-Cβ-null versus matched-intact comparison mapped to the candidate.

normalization.reference: single source-site q75 = 0.183712 absolute LFC; no site-count adjustment
normalization.help: Multiplies the same PKA-Cβ-KO site-level q75 for every site pattern. Each protein inherits its strongest site's factor; proteins without detected sites remain neutral.

node_streams.label: Collecting duct proteome - CCD
node_streams.description: Rat CCD protein abundance mapped to mouse genes with audited Ensembl orthology.

normalization.help: Multiplies the CCD-specific q75 derived from all positive rat-proteome measurements; zero/nondetected values stay neutral.

node_streams.label: Collecting duct proteome - OMCD
node_streams.description: Rat OMCD protein abundance mapped to mouse genes with audited Ensembl orthology.

normalization.help: Multiplies the OMCD-specific q75 derived from all positive rat-proteome measurements; zero/nondetected values stay neutral.

node_streams.label: Collecting duct proteome - IMCD
node_streams.description: Rat IMCD protein abundance mapped to mouse genes with audited Ensembl orthology.

normalization.help: Multiplies the IMCD-specific q75 derived from all positive rat-proteome measurements; zero/nondetected values stay neutral.

node_streams.label: Collecting duct RNA - CCD
node_streams.description: Mouse CCD segment RNA abundance from the renal-tubule RNA-seq table.

normalization.help: Multiplies the CCD-specific q75 derived from all positive RNA measurements; zero/nondetected values stay neutral.

node_streams.label: Collecting duct RNA - OMCD
node_streams.description: Mouse OMCD segment RNA abundance from the renal-tubule RNA-seq table.

normalization.help: Multiplies the OMCD-specific q75 derived from all positive RNA measurements; zero/nondetected values stay neutral.

node_streams.label: Collecting duct RNA - IMCD
node_streams.description: Mouse IMCD segment RNA abundance from the renal-tubule RNA-seq table.

normalization.help: Multiplies the IMCD-specific q75 derived from all positive RNA measurements; zero/nondetected values stay neutral.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: Both proteins have valid mpkCCD fractionation profiles, but their pair has no non-neutral localization factor.

normalization.help: Multiplies every node-specific q75 localization threshold before reciprocal symmetrization.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: One endpoint is an ontology-annotated kinase and the other has at least one observed, scorable phosphosite, but no non-neutral top-ten motif prediction links the pair.

normalization.help: Multiplies each observed phosphosite's motif-score threshold before top-ten kinase hits are combined.

edge_streams.label: STRING v12
edge_streams.description: Mouse functional associations from STRING v12.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: Both protein nodes have valid STRING mouse identifiers, but the pair has no non-neutral STRING association record.

normalization.help: STRING uses a reference odds score rather than the Gaussian Tq kernel. This multiplier changes that reference score.

edge_streams.label: HPA primary localization
edge_streams.description: Enhanced, Supported, and Approved HPA localization calls.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: Both proteins have valid HPA primary localization profiles, but their pair has no non-neutral HPA localization factor.

normalization.help: Multiplies HPA primary-profile thresholds before reciprocal symmetrization.

edge_streams.label: HPA high confidence
edge_streams.description: Enhanced and Supported HPA calls only; sensitivity alternative to HPA primary.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: Both proteins have valid HPA high-confidence localization profiles, but their pair has no non-neutral HPA localization factor.

normalization.help: Multiplies HPA Enhanced/Supported-profile thresholds before reciprocal symmetrization.

edge_streams.label: OmniPath core
edge_streams.description: Core mouse signaling interactions collapsed to unsigned, undirected pairs.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: Both endpoints are proteins in the selected graph, but OmniPath contains no non-neutral core interaction for the pair. This is an optional database-absence assumption, not proof of no interaction.

normalization.help: Multiplies the q75 curation-effort threshold from all mouse OmniPath pairs.

edge_streams.label: STITCH v5 messenger–protein
edge_streams.description: Mouse protein–chemical associations for the curated secondary-messenger nodes.

negative_evidence.absence_definition: One endpoint is a curated messenger represented in STITCH and the other is a STRING-mapped protein, but STITCH contains no non-neutral association for the pair.

normalization.help: STITCH uses combined-score odds relative to its 0.150 reporting floor. This multiplier changes that reference score; missing records remain neutral.

edge_streams.label: Scaffold-mediated closure
edge_streams.description: Fixed one-pass evidence for protein pairs that each have a strong edge to the same adaptor/scaffold.

parameters.label: Anchor >
parameters.help: A protein-scaffold edge must exceed this pre-closure probability before it can support closure.

parameters.label: Support L
parameters.help: Likelihood assigned to every qualifying pair. Relative to the neutral likelihood 0.5, the default 0.90 gives BF = 1.8.

normalization.reference: Binary shared-scaffold rule; no empirical Tq or scaffold-degree penalty
normalization.help: Closure uses the Anchor and Support L controls and is calculated once without recursive feedback.

path_ontology_classes.label: Receptor
path_ontology_classes.description: Proteins annotated under molecular transducer activity or signaling receptor activity.

path_ontology_classes.label: Ligand
path_ontology_classes.description: Receptor ligands and signaling-receptor binding proteins.

path_ontology_classes.label: Phospholipase
path_ontology_classes.description: Phosphatidylinositol phospholipase C activity and its descendants.

path_ontology_classes.label: GTPase regulator
path_ontology_classes.description: GTPase regulatory, exchange-factor, and activating activities.

path_ontology_classes.label: Kinase/phosphatase binding
path_ontology_classes.description: Kinase, phosphatase, and protein kinase A binding activities.

path_ontology_classes.label: Signaling process
path_ontology_classes.description: Broad signaling, signal transduction, intracellular signaling, and cell communication processes.

path_ontology_classes.label: Second messenger
path_ontology_classes.description: Curated non-protein second-messenger molecules; this class is not derived from a GO root.

path_ontology_classes.label: Adaptor/scaffold
path_ontology_classes.description: Molecular adaptor and molecular scaffold activity. Disabled by default but available for sensitivity analyses.
